title: The Kakeya maximal conjecture in three dimensions
summary: We prove the Kakeya maximal conjecture in three dimensions. For every ε > 0, the maximal average over unit tubes of radius δ maps $`L^3(\mathbb R^3)`$ to $`L^3(S^2)`$ with norm at most $`C_\varepsilon\delta^{-\varepsilon}`$.
family_title: Kakeya in three and four dimensions

review.reason: Proves a near-sharp L3 maximal estimate for unit tubes in three dimensions.
